description: This file is a shell script used as a test runner for a software project. It contains functions to apply patches idempotently, ensure specific revisions of dependencies, build the project with CMake, and run tests via ctest. The script orchestrates the setup, patching, building, and testing processes in a CI/CD environment.

methods.name: apply_patch_idempotent
methods.description: Applies a patch idempotently and non-interactively, checking if the patch can be applied or if it is already applied.

methods.name: ensure_thundertools_expected_revision
methods.description: Pins ThunderTools to a specific revision (default R4.4.3) by checking out the correct git commit/tag.

methods.name: run_build_and_l1_tests
methods.description: Configures the build environment, builds the project using CMake, and runs the tests via ctest.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main orchestrator function that applies patches, ensures dependencies are at correct revisions, builds, and tests.
